## what changed and why

Describe the question, correction, or organizational improvement. Link related issues.

## evidence and limits

For technical claims, link sources or reproducible results. Distinguish proposed behavior from verified capability. State what was not checked.

## review

- [ ] Relevant catalogue entries and repository links are updated.
- [ ] Checks pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] Changed visuals have been inspected in both themes.
- [ ] No credentials, sensitive data, or unrelated generated artifacts are included.
